description_en: Retrieves Real User Monitoring (RUM) exception stack information
kebab_example: aliyun arms get-rum-exception-stack --pid atxxxxzkcf@d8deedfa9bf0000 --exception-stack 'call_stack.info_:_libsystem_kernel.dylib_0x00000001f1ce9178_0x00000001f1ce8000_+_4472_r_nlibsystem_kernel.dylib_0x00000001f1ce8f10_0x00000001f1ce8000_+_3856_r_nlibsystem_kernel.dylib_0x00000001f1ced718_0x00000001f1ce8000_+_22296_r_nAlibabaCloudRUM_0x0000000106711af4_0x0000000106660000_+_727796_r_nlibsystem_pthread.dylib_0x00000002146744d4_0x0000000214672000_+_9428_,_call_stack.thread.name_:_#3_BRSCrash_Exception_Handler_Secondary_,_call_stack.thread.id_:_16643' --exception-binary-images iOSDemo:arm64%3B1489F4D3-6DE2-300C-90E9-E1B869675351%3B0x0000000104064000_nAlibabaCloudRUM:arm64%3BAB7B3A8E-6CEE-325D-BCBB-8DA50E61804F%3B0x0000000106660000_nlibdispatch.dylib:arm --exception-thread-id 16643 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --sourcemap-type js --extra-info GraphicsServices:system/GraphicsServices/85419099-269B-336D-86B4-0D52D0FF6923/GraphicsServices_WebCore:system/WebCore/BF44A3F4-85D4-38C8-BF26-197F06ADE273/WebCore --workspace example-string --service-id example-string --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetRumExceptionStack

parameters.help_en: The error stack information in JSON list format. Each list element contains three fields: call_stack.info, call_stack.thread.name, and call_stack.thread.id, which represent the stack information, thread name, and thread ID, respectively. This is identical to the exception.stack field in the Simple Log Service logstore-rum
parameters.help_zh: 错误堆栈信息，JSON列表格式，列表元素包括call_stack.info、call_stack.thread.name和call_stack.thread.id三个字段，分别代表堆栈信息、线程名称和线程id，同SLS的logstore-rum中的exception.stack字段完全一致
parameters.name: exception_stack

parameters.help_en: The binary images, which represent all executable files loaded into the process address space at the time of the crash
parameters.help_zh: Binary Images，表示在崩溃时装载到进程地址空间的所有可执行文件
parameters.name: exception_binary_images

parameters.help_en:
The parsing type. Valid values:
js: JavaScript error parsing
sym: PC parsing
har: HarmonyOS parsing
dSYM: iOS parsing
so: Android parsing
parameters.help_zh:
指定解析类型
js：JS 错误解析
sym：PC 端解析
har：鸿蒙端解析
dSYM： iOS 端解析
so: 安卓端解析
parameters.name: sourcemap_type

parameters.help_en: The additional system symbol table information for iOS parsing. This parameter is optional
parameters.help_zh: 在 iOS 端解析额外的系统符号表信息，用户可不填
parameters.name: extra_info

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates success

BinaryImages.description_en: The names and UUIDs of the system symbol tables required for exception stack parsing. This field is returned only for PC parsing
BinaryImages.description_zh: PC 端解析会透出，解析异常堆栈所需的系统符号表的名字与 UUID

CrashAddress.description_en: The crash address. This field is returned only for PC parsing
CrashAddress.description_zh: PC端解析时会透出，崩溃地址

CrashReason.description_en: The exception reason. This field is returned only for PC parsing
CrashReason.description_zh: PC端解析时会透出，异常原因

items.description_zh: 解析后的错误堆栈信息

ModuleName.description_en: The name of the crash parsing module. This field is returned only for PC parsing
ModuleName.description_zh: PC 端解析时会透出，崩溃解析模块名

ThreadInfoList.description_en: The thread stack details captured during a PC crash
ThreadInfoList.description_zh: PC 端崩溃，抓取的线程堆栈详情

ThreadTag.description_en: The thread tag, which includes the thread number and thread name
ThreadTag.description_zh: 线程标签（包含线程号和线程名）

Uuid.description_en: The UUID of the symbol table required for stack parsing. This field is returned only for PC parsing
Uuid.description_zh: PC 端解析会透出，解析堆栈所需符号表的 UUID

Message.description_en: The message returned when the call fails
Message.description_zh: 调用失败时返回的信息
Message.example: 内部错误，请联系管理员。

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

`true`: The request was successful.
`false`: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

`true`：操作成功
`false`：操作失败
